(i) the relationship between product diversity and performance is complex and nonlinear, and (ii) product diversity and geographic diversity interact in determining performance.

product diversification and geographic diversification have a complex and non-monotonic relationship with firm performance in the property-liability insurance industry.

product diversification is a complex phenomenon that is likely to be influenced by a host of factors, including geographic diversification, firm size, and market returns, and that its relationship with firm performance is not a straightforward one.
